text:
```yaml
name: copilot-setup-steps

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Node.js and Install Dependencies
        uses: kubb-labs/config/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: true
          force-install: false

      - name: Build all packages via Turbo
        run: pnpm turbo run build --filter=* --parallel
```

And update `.github/copilot-instructions.md` with the following content:

# Formatting and checks (CRITICAL)

To ensure high-quality contributions, please follow these steps before committing your changes:

1. Run `pnpm run format` to format your code according to our style guidelines.
2. Run `pnpm run check` to perform linting, type checking, and other validations.
3. Ensure all checks pass successfully before submitting your pull request or pushing your changes.

By adhering to these guidelines, you help maintain a clean and consistent codebase, which improves the overall quality of our project.
